_note: Hand fixes applied by tools/build_champion_pool.py on top of the parsed game data, for abilities the generic parser can't read correctly. Per champion id and ability slot: cooldown (seconds, max rank), onhit_every (the ability is a passive that procs on every Nth attack instead of being cast), skip (ability has no damage worth modelling), cast_time (seconds before it fires), lock (seconds a channel keeps the caster busy after that), attack_reset (the next attack can start right away). Add to this file when a champion's results look wrong.
